game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must hold off sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Then check gate_integrity and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from sea serpents in Harbor Docks: keep gate_integrity above zero until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 3, Level 1, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
